intended_object: The additive homomorphism from the free abelian group on M × N to A that a balanced map induces. Its docstring calls it "an implementation detail of `BalancedTensorProduct.lift`".
explanation: This is an auxiliary step in building the lift out of the balanced tensor product, which is a quotient of a free abelian group. The definition applies `FreeAbelianGroup.lift` to the balanced map, uncurried. The docstring says outright that it is an implementation detail. It is not a standalone mathematical notion; it only exists to define `lift`.
